title: [GMCP 203.037.06] Operations and evidence: Configuration import, export, migration, and desired state
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-037-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: GMCP losslessly imports and exports major MCP host configurations while separating secrets, preserving unknown fields and reporting unsupported semantics. One versioned desired-state schema covers servers, transports, auth, sandbox, policy and extensions; migrations are reversible and idempotent; layered overrides explain provenance; and concurrent edits use validation plus atomic conflict handling. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
